description: Trust Modaraba commenced operations in 1991 as a perpetual, multi-purpose Modaraba engaged in Murabahah, Musharakah and Ijarah financing, equity investments and trading. It is managed by Al-Zamin Modaraba Management (Private) Limited and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
